items.name: Seed Audio 1.0
items.description: Seed Audio 1.0 — text-to-audio synthesis with optional voice/audio reference or a single image reference.

parameters.name: speech_rate
parameters.description: Speech speed adjustment. 0 keeps the default speed; positive values are faster.

parameters.name: pitch_rate
parameters.description: Pitch adjustment in provider units. 0 keeps the default pitch.

items.name: Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS Flash
items.description: Qwen Audio 3.0 TTS Flash with expressive instructions and a selectable system preset or cloned reference-element voice.

parameters.name: voice_type
parameters.description: Use 'preset' for a system voice or 'element' for a cloned voice.

items.name: Eleven v4
items.description: Eleven v4 speech generation with up to 10 preset or reference-element voices. Dialogue text is limited to 10,000 characters in total.

parameters.name: dialogue
parameters.description: Ordered speech turns with a required voice per turn; 10,000 characters in total.

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: Number of independent variations to generate.

items.name: Eleven v4 Turbo
items.description: Eleven v4 Turbo speech generation with one preset or reference-element voice.

parameters.name: dialogue
parameters.description: Ordered speech turns with a required voice per turn.

items.name: Sonilo Music
items.description: Text-to-music generation with controllable duration. Game pipeline only.

items.name: Mirelo Text to Audio
items.description: Text-to-audio sound effect generation with controllable duration. Game pipeline only.

items.name: Inworld Text to Speech
items.description: Text-to-speech audio generation. Game pipeline only.

parameters.name: voice
parameters.description: Voice to use for text-to-speech synthesis (language tag in parentheses).

items.name: Text to Speech V2
items.description: Text-to-speech with a selectable engine (ElevenLabs, MiniMax, Seed Speech, Vibe Voice, Cozy Voice) via the variant param; preset or reference-element voices (voice_type + voice_id).

parameters.name: voice_type
parameters.description: Whether voice_id is a built-in preset voice ('preset') or a workspace reference element ('element').

parameters.name: voice_id
parameters.description: Voice id: a preset voice id when voice_type='preset', or a reference element id when voice_type='element'.
